title: Morph config
description: Configures Morph's generated Go mappers, package pairs, type pairs, defaults, discovery, conversions, and reusable presets.

defaults.description: Default values applied before presets, packages, and type-level overrides.

discovery.description: Packages Morph scans for reusable mapping functions and methods.

conversions.description: Explicit named-type conversions Morph may use when source and target types are compatible.

packages.description: Package pairs and root type pairs Morph should generate mappers for.

presets.description: Named type defaults that packages or types can opt into using 'preset'.

packages.description: Defaults for every configured package pair.

types.description: Defaults for every configured type pair.

callables.description: Lowest-priority callable references available to every type mapping.

mappers.description: Defaults for generated mapper function names and signatures.

conversions.description: Default policy for using configured named-type conversions.

bidirectional.description: Whether type mappings generate both forward and inverse mappers by default.

packages.description: Go packages whose exported functions and methods Morph can choose to use for mapping, if compatible.

targets.description: Types Morph may convert the source type to.

bidirectional.description: Whether the same conversion(s) should also be available in reverse.

source.description: Go package containing the source type(s).

target.description: Go package containing the target type(s).

preset.description: Preset to apply before package-level options.

bidirectional.description: Whether type mappings in this package generate inverse mappers unless overridden.

output.description: Settings for generated output for this package pair.

callables.description: Callable references available to type mappings in this package pair; preferred over package preset and default callables.

enum.description: Enum defaults for type mappings in this package pair.

mappers.description: Mapper defaults for type mappings in this package pair.

optionality.description: Optionality defaults for type mappings in this package pair.

conversions.description: Conversion policy defaults for type mappings in this package pair.

types.description: Type pairs to map between the source and target packages.

name.description: Shared type name to use when source and target type names are the same.

source.description: Source type name within the source package; defaults to name when omitted.

target.description: Target type name within the target package; defaults to name when omitted.

preset.description: Preset to apply before type-level options.

bidirectional.description: Whether this type mapping should also generate an inverse mapper.

callables.description: Highest-priority scoped callable references for this type mapping.

enum.description: Enum matching and failure behavior for this type mapping.

struct.description: Explicit field mappings and field-level policies for this type mapping.

mappers.description: Generated mapper function names and signatures for this type mapping.

optionality.description: Pointer/value optionality policy for this type mapping.

conversions.description: Conversion policy for this type mapping.

enum.description: Enum defaults supplied by this preset.

callables.description: Callable references supplied by this preset; priority depends on whether the preset is applied to a package or type.

mappers.description: Mapper defaults supplied by this preset.

optionality.description: Optionality defaults supplied by this preset.

conversions.description: Conversion policy supplied by this preset.

bidirectional.description: Whether this preset makes type mappings bidirectional by default.

failureMode.description: Default behavior when an enum source value has no target match.

patterns.description: Default templates used to normalize source and target enum value names before matching.

failureMode.description: Behavior when an enum source value has no target match.

patterns.description: Templates used to normalize source and target enum value names before matching.

values.description: Explicit source enum value to target enum value mappings.

source.description: Template for source enum value names.

target.description: Template for target enum value names.

fields.description: Explicit source field mappings keyed by source field name.

omit.description: Source and target fields intentionally omitted from struct mapping coverage.

target.description: Target field name; defaults to the source field name when omitted.

callable.description: Explicit callable to use for this field.

optionality.description: Pointer/value optionality policy for this field.

forward.description: Callable to use for the forward field mapping.

inverse.description: Callable to use for the inverse field mapping.

source.description: Source fields intentionally not mapped to target fields.

target.description: Target fields intentionally left at their zero value.

forward.description: Defaults for the forward mapper function.

inverse.description: Defaults for the inverse mapper function.

name.description: Generated mapper function name or Go template for the name.

signature.description: Generated mapper function parameter and return shape.

accepts.description: Whether the generated mapper accepts source values or pointers.

returns.description: Whether the generated mapper returns target values or pointers.

onNilSourcePointer.description: Behavior when a source pointer is nil.

onZeroSourceValue.description: Behavior when a source value maps to a target pointer.

enabled.description: Whether configured named-type conversions may be used.

strategy.description: How generated files are grouped by package.

path.description: Output directory for the single_package strategy.

package.description: Generated Go package name for the single_package strategy.

enumFailureMode.description: error returns an error for unmapped enum values; zero returns the target type's zero value.

parameterKind.description: Whether a mapper parameter or return is a value or pointer.

pointerOptionality.description: zero maps nil source pointers to zero values; error makes nil source pointers fail.

valueOptionality.description: nil maps zero source values to nil target pointers; address maps zero source values to their address.

outputStrategy.description: single_package writes one package; source_package writes beside source packages; target_package writes beside target packages.

goPackagePath.description: Go import path for a package.

typeName.description: Go type name within the configured package pair.

typeRef.description: Go type reference, either a local/predeclared type name or an imported type as import/path.Type.

callableRef.description: Go callable reference as import/path.Function or import/path.Type.Method.

enumPattern.description: Go template for enum value names using .Type and .Value with Raw, Pascal, Camel, Kebab, Snake, or Screaming.
